title: Preserve business filters when recommending Record.Get
summary: The performance guidance for replacing FindFirst with Record.Get now clarifies that additional business filters must be preserved, either by keeping the filtered FindFirst or by enforcing equivalent conditions after Get.
key_points: Prevents false-positive recommendations when lookups combine full primary-key filters with other business conditions
Documents that Record.Get ignores normal record filters, only respecting security filters
Recommends two valid alternatives: retain filtered FindFirst or explicitly check business conditions after Get
Extends examples to show both the problematic pattern and correct solutions
Ensures performance recommendations do not introduce behavior-changing corrections
